name: Contract breach with email timeline contradiction
description: Draft says defendant first objected after termination, but an earlier email objects before termination.

documents.text: Plaintiff's draft motion states that Defendant first objected after termination and that the breach is undisputed. Plaintiff seeks damages under the services agreement.
Section 4 requires written notice of material nonconformity within ten days. Section 12 contains an integration clause.

emails.subject: Objection before termination
emails.text:
From: defendant@example.com
To: plaintiff@example.com
Date: March 3, 2025 9:00 AM EST
Subject: Objection before termination

We object to the invoice and reserve all rights. The work does not conform to Section 4.

From: plaintiff@example.com
To: defendant@example.com
Date: March 10, 2025 4:00 PM EST
Subject: Termination

We terminate the agreement effective today.
